status: digital V8 body-seam and rear-bezel service-clearance candidate; physical full-shell fit and remaining production systems are still required before final ASA release

seam_relief.construction: derive each actual seated overlap, split it into local closed components, expand each component by 0.6 mm in XYZ, and subtract only those local envelopes from the configured receiver

acceptance_holds: V8 may remove only localized collision material from V7. It may not add exterior geometry or move any V0.5-M2 plate hole, rail axis, socket datum, M4 station, or aluminum-owned feature.
Rear-bezel relief must cover the complete densely sampled straight outward service path, not merely the seated pose.
Every production body, rear bezel, bottom keel, and socket cap must remain one closed manifold component.
Seated exposed seam contact is permitted, but no pair may retain positive volumetric overlap. Every nonzero assembly-path offset must be triangle-collision free.
No relief cutter may intersect the inset and chamfered mirror-cap landing polygons selected by the accepted mirror-facet prototype configuration.
Boolean-created detached slivers may be discarded only below the configured 5 mm3 per-operation limit and must be reported.

V8 establishes complementary seam ownership and assembly clearance. Final seam fastener or bridge-plate retention, ears, eyes, glow panels, lamp and steering portals, and physical full-shell fit remain separate production blockers.
A support/brim-inclusive Prusa MK4 Generic ASA slice with at least 10 mm XY margin is required before this candidate can advance.
